notes: Trigger evals, written with the skill and not run yet: there is no grader for them. Ids 0-3 and 6-10 must trigger np-communications; ids 4-5 must NOT (they belong to np-notification-manager, the agent notification channels under /notification). The assertions describe the behavior to check by hand from the transcript. Every write must stop at the confirmation, so the evals can run against a real organization: answer no (id 10 does it explicitly). The only thing they may create is the send test of id 0, which lands in the caller's own bell.

evals.name: emit-from-ci
evals.prompt: Our Trivy scan runs in GitHub Actions. When it finds a critical CVE I want the service owner to get it in their nullplatform bell, and retries of the job must not notify twice. How do I set that up?
evals.expected_output: Triggers np-communications. Proposes an invoked inbox rule with a context_schema that requires id, validates it, dry-runs and sends a test to the caller before saving, then shows the emission (POST /communications/inbox_rule/<id>/emission or the CLI) with a context.id derived from the finding, and explains 200 existing / 409.
assertions: read GET /communications/inbox_rule/schema (or /source) before drafting
the drafted rule has source { kind: invoked } and context_schema.required includes id
ran POST /communications/inbox_rule/validate before any save
offered ?dry_run=true and deliver_to: me before activating
asked for confirmation before POST /communications/inbox_rule
context.id is stable per finding, distinct per resource, and the 409 case is explained
never used curl from the session

evals.name: scheduled-maintenance-banner
evals.prompt: Publish a maintenance banner for Saturday 02:00-04:00 UTC in the Development section and the bell, only for admins and ops, and have it disappear on its own when the window ends.
evals.expected_output: Triggers np-communications. Builds a broadcast with category platform.maintenance, severity maintenance, inbox and banner surfaces (banner sections [development]), audience.grants [admin, ops], publish_at before the window and expires_at at its end, and a group_key; checks for other live banners; asks for confirmation before POST /communications/notification.
assertions: kind is broadcast and category is platform.maintenance
surfaces has an inbox entry and a banner entry with sections [development]
audience.grants lists admin and ops and audience.organizations is not set
expires_at is the end of the window, in UTC
set a group_key on the announcement
listed live announcements (GET /communications/notification/manage) before publishing
asked for confirmation before the POST

evals.name: why-not-deployment-failed
evals.prompt: Juana is the owner of the payments-api application but she never gets the 'Deployment failed' notification when its deployments fail. Why?
evals.expected_output: Triggers np-communications. Reads the deployment.failed rule, checks organization_state and any edited copy, explains that its reading reaches the person who started the deployment (and followers), so an owner who did not start it needs Everything on that application in Inbox settings, and says that another person's Inbox settings cannot be read through the API.
assertions: read GET /communications/inbox_rule (or /inbox_rule/deployment.failed)
checked organization_state.enabled and customized
explained the requester audience and the watchers/Everything path
did not claim to read Juana's inbox settings through the API
suggested setting the rule to Everything on the application in Inbox settings

evals.name: list-inbox-rules
evals.prompt: Which inbox rules do we have in our org, and which built-in ones did we turn off?
evals.expected_output: Triggers np-communications. Calls GET /communications/inbox_rule once and summarizes built-in vs custom, edited built-ins, organization_state.enabled false, scope and default mode.
assertions: used GET /communications/inbox_rule through np-api
separated built-in rules (organization_id null) from custom ones
reported built-in rules with organization_state.enabled false

evals.name: agent-channel-must-not-trigger
evals.prompt: Create a notification channel so my k8s agent with tags cluster:runtime receives the deployment actions of the kubernetes-custom scope.
assertions: did not load np-communications
did not call any /communications path

evals.name: resend-agent-notification-must-not-trigger
evals.prompt: The agent never ran the create action of my postgres service. Resend notification 8812 to channel 12346.
evals.expected_output: Uses np-notification-manager (or np-service-craft resend), not np-communications.
assertions: did not load np-communications
did not call any /communications path

evals.name: close-thread-stops-at-confirmation
evals.prompt: The incident is over. Close every announcement of the incident-2026-10-22 thread.
evals.expected_output: Triggers np-communications. Lists open notifications sharing group_key incident-2026-10-22 (GET /communications/notification/manage), says how many it would close and that POST /close also closes personal notifications sharing that key, then asks for confirmation before POST /communications/notification/close.
assertions: listed the announcements sharing the group_key before closing
warned that /close closes every open notification with that key, not only announcements
asked for confirmation before POST /communications/notification/close
did not call DELETE

evals.name: edit-built-in-deployment-failed
evals.prompt: I want to change the wording of the built-in Deployment failed notification for our org and also send it to the namespace owner.
evals.expected_output: Triggers np-communications. Explains that POSTing a document with the built-in id deployment.failed edits the built-in for the organization (not a new rule), starts from GET /communications/inbox_rule/deployment.failed's document, keeps visible_to at the organization root, validates, saves with ?dry_run=true, and confirms before saving. Mentions Reset to default (DELETE .../customization).
assertions: read GET /communications/inbox_rule/deployment.failed
explained that the same id edits the built-in instead of creating a new rule
did not try an emission (the rule rides an entity)
ran validate and a ?dry_run=true save before the real save
asked for confirmation before POST /communications/inbox_rule
mentioned DELETE /communications/inbox_rule/deployment.failed/customization to undo it

evals.name: change-my-inbox-settings
evals.prompt: Turn on email for deployment failures in my inbox settings.
evals.expected_output: Triggers np-communications. May read the caller's own settings (GET /communications/inbox_setting, rows with channel email) and the category defaults, but explains that this skill does not write inbox settings and points to Inbox settings in the dashboard (bell settings icon, or User settings > Inbox).
assertions: did not call PUT /communications/inbox_setting
explained email is a per-person setting off by default unless the rule says otherwise
pointed to Inbox settings in the dashboard

evals.name: ci-to-slack-boundary
evals.prompt: Every time a deployment fails in the payments namespace I want a message in our #payments-alerts Slack channel.
evals.expected_output: Triggers np-communications, not np-notification-manager: the message is for people. Explains that a delivery destination on the Deployment failed rule's category for the payments namespace NRN posts it to Slack, that destinations are created in Platform Settings > Communications (this skill reads them), checks the Slack installation and existing destinations at the namespace and its ancestors, and warns that everyone in the channel reads it.
assertions: did not hand off to np-notification-manager
did not propose an announcement
proposed a delivery destination, created in the dashboard
checked GET /communications/slack/status and existing destinations at the NRN and its ancestors

evals.name: user-declines-publish
evals.prompt: Publish an announcement to everyone saying the new Communications section is live. (When asked to confirm, answer: no, not yet.)
evals.expected_output: Triggers np-communications. Drafts the broadcast, shows the body and the request, asks for confirmation, and after the no stops without calling POST /communications/notification.
assertions: showed the full body before asking
asked for confirmation
did not call POST /communications/notification after the user declined
